instruction: An observatory on the lunar surface: a cluster of radio telescope dishes aimed at the sky, a domed optical telescope with an open shutter, a low habitat module with lit portholes, a parked rover with wire wheels, footprint and track trails in the regolith, a crater rim behind, antennae with blinking tips, and a brilliant blue Earthrise above the gray horizon.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Lunar Observatory Outpost. An observatory on the lunar surface: a cluster of radio telescope dishes aimed at the sky, a domed optical telescope with an open shutter, a low habitat module with lit portholes, a parked rover with wire wheels, footprint and track trails in the regolith, a crater rim behind, antennae with blinking tips, and a brilliant blue Earthrise above the gray horizon. Style: quiet hard sci-fi. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
